doc: Duel screen prompt widgets. Each prompt in duel_prompts names one. Each row generates a widget class under dev.duelcraft.client.prompt.

rows.shows: Clicking a card in hand/field lists what it can do now (Summon, Special Summon, Set, Activate <effect>, Change position); buttons for Battle Phase / End Phase / Shuffle.
rows.input: click card -> action menu; click phase button

rows.shows: Battle: attackers glow; click one to attack (opponent then picks target via card_picker); activatable effects; Main Phase 2 / End Phase buttons.
Question text (effect description or system string) with the card's art.
A vertical list of option texts.
Grid of candidate cards with art, location label, min/max counter; for sums the running total.
rows.input: toggle cards, Confirm (enabled when valid), Cancel if allowed

rows.shows: Like card_picker but one card per answer; already chosen cards are marked.
rows.input: click a card; Finish when finishable

rows.shows: 'Chain an effect?' with the activatable cards.
rows.input: click a card to activate, or Pass (unless forced)

rows.shows: Highlights the free zones on the field.
The card in each allowed position (face-up ATK, face-up DEF, face-down DEF...).

rows.input: Keep order, or click cards in the order wanted

rows.shows: Cards with counters and +/- steppers, total required.
Toggle buttons for each available Type or Attribute, 'pick N'.
Text box filtering Master Duel card names to the ones allowed; list of matches.
